text: Found it: in middleware/proxy.go the balancers (`randomBalancer.Next` / `roundRobinBalancer.Next`) index into `b.targets` without checking for an empty target list, so a balancer with no targets panics instead of returning 503. A subagent is applying the fix (return nil when empty + `ErrServiceUnavailable` in the proxy handler) and running the full test suite to make sure nothing else breaks. ETA ~6 min.

Fixed and verified. In `middleware/proxy.go`: `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now return `nil` when the target list is empty (previously they panicked with `invalid argument to Intn` / `integer divide by zero`), and the `ProxyWithConfig` handler returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) when the balancer yields no target. A balancer with no targets now answers 503 instead of panicking, so `TestProxyBalancerWithNoTargets` passes. `go build ./...`, `go vet ./middleware/` and the full `go test ./...` are green — no pre-existing test regressed, and no test files were touched.
